Through my recent conversations with various individuals, it has become increasingly clear to me that the uncertainty surrounding tariffs, potential job losses due to automation, and lingering effects of inflation make an imminent recovery highly unlikely. Many have echoed concerns over affordability, particularly concerning essential expenses like healthcare, further supporting the notion that significant improvements within the specified timeframe appear improbable.
